pyqgis_plugin.name: Urban Heat Island (Landsat 10/11)
pyqgis_plugin.description: Turn a place, date and radius into easy-to-read temperature and heat-zone maps
pyqgis_plugin.about: Just enter a date, a place name, the latitude and longitude of the centre of your area, and a radius. The plugin finds the clearest nearby Landsat satellite image and adds two ready-to-use layers to QGIS: a ground temperature map in degrees Celsius, and a simple five-zone map showing which parts of the area are cool, average, warm or hot spots. Clouds and water are left out automatically. If you have the satellite files in a folder, point the plugin to it; otherwise let it download them using your AWS account or USGS login. The plugin works in the background without freezing QGIS. The README has step-by-step instructions written for GIS analysts.
